requirements.text: Proposals must be emailed to the Research Director at MoDOTResearchRFP@modot.mo.gov by 10 a.m. Central on the due date, August 21, 2024, according to the email time stamp.
requirements.quote: Proposals must be emailed by 10 a.m. Central  according to time stamp on the due date indicated

requirements.text: The submittal must include a project plan, the proposed project team and its background, and any related projects now active or recently completed by the firm.
requirements.quote: The submittal must include a project plan, the proposed project team and its background, and any related projects now active or recently completed by your firm.

requirements.text: Questions and comments about the RFP must be sent to the Research Director by email by the deadline of 7/17/2024, 4 p.m. Central.
requirements.quote: Any and all questions regarding specifications, requirements, competitive procurement process, or other questions must be directed to the  Research Director

requirements.text: Offerors must not contact MoDOT employees about the RFP by any method other than the designated email address; doing so is cause for disqualification.
requirements.quote: contacting MoDOT employees via other methods is prohibited.

requirements.text: The proposal must include all data required in the Required Elements of Proposal section, or it may be disqualified.
requirements.quote: The Offeror must respond to this RFP by submitting all data required in paragraph (B) below for its proposal to be evaluated and considered for award.

requirements.text: The Offeror must submit its proposal accepting that all proposals and related information are open to public inspection, without reservations.
requirements.quote: Therefore, the Offeror must submit its proposal based on such conditions without reservations.

requirements.text: The proposal should reference the project number and title, since more than one RFP may be due at the same time.
requirements.quote: Please reference the project number and title since more than one RFP may be due at one time.

requirements.text: The Work Plan section of the proposal should be no longer than ten pages and use a font size of at least 12 points, excluding forms and resumes.
requirements.quote: This section should be no longer than ten (10) pages in length, with a font size no less than 12 points.

requirements.text: The project plan must include all items outlined in Section 2 (Scope of Work).
requirements.quote: The project plan shall include all items outlined in Section 2

requirements.text: The project plan must recognize MoDOT's ultimate authority to approve the work plans.
requirements.quote: recognize the ultimate authority of MoDOT to approve the work plans

requirements.text: Proposals must include a work plan with a proposed timeline.
requirements.quote: Proposals need to include a work plan with a proposed timeline.

requirements.text: The Personnel section should give the name, location, telephone number and email address of the Offeror's primary contact person.
requirements.quote: Please indicate the name, location, telephone number, and email address of the primary contact person for the Offeror.

requirements.text: The Offeror must provide a complete listing of each sub-offeror, if any, with complete contact information.
requirements.quote: The Offeror must furnish a complete listing of each Sub-Offeror, if any, and complete contact information for that Sub-Offeror.

requirements.text: The proposal must clearly identify the Offeror's experience in offering the requested services during the past three years.
requirements.quote: The proposal must clearly identify the  experience in offering the services requested in this RFP during the past three (3) years.

requirements.text: Proposals should give the name, title and telephone number of at least three client officials from within the past three years as references.
requirements.quote: Proposals should indicate the name, title, and telephone number of at least three officials of clients within the past three years.

requirements.text: The proposal must be submitted as a single combined PDF document.
requirements.quote: Proposals must be submitted as one combined PDF document.

requirements.text: The proposal must contain only the required documents, in this order: Proposal Submission Form, Cover Letter, Body of Proposal (including work plan and project schedule), Personnel, Organization's Project Experience, Team Member Experience, and Organization's Client References.
requirements.quote: organized in the following order: 1) Proposal Submission Form; 2) Cover Letter (Optional; 1 page maximum); 3) Body of Proposal (including work plan and project schedule); 4) Personnel;  5) Organization's Project Experience; 6) Team Member Experience; and 7) Organization's Client References.

requirements.text: A cover letter is optional and, if included, must not exceed one page.
requirements.quote: Cover Letter (Optional; 1 page maximum)

requirements.text: The Offeror must submit a proposed cost estimate covering all services defined in the Scope of Work.
requirements.quote: The Offeror must submit a proposed cost estimate for all services defined in the Scope of Work.

requirements.text: The cost estimate must be shown on the Section (4) Price Page, which must be completed, signed and returned with the proposal.
requirements.quote: This estimate must be shown on Section (4), Price Page, of this proposal which must be completed, signed, and returned with the Offeror's proposal.

requirements.text: The Offeror agrees to provide the services at the fees it quotes, under the terms of the RFP.
requirements.quote: The Offeror agrees to provide the services at the fees quoted, under the terms of this RFP.

requirements.text: The services must be provided for a price not exceeding $175,000.
requirements.quote: The successful Offeror shall provide the following services not to exceed $175,000.

requirements.text: The contract period will be 15 months.
requirements.quote: The contract period will run for 15 months.

requirements.text: The project timeline presumes the project starts on November 1, 2024.
requirements.quote: presuming the project starts November 1, 2024

requirements.text: The Offeror must submit quarterly updates on work accomplished on or before the last working day of March, June, September and December throughout the project.
requirements.quote: Quarterly updates on work accomplished during the quarter are due on or before the last working day of March, June, September, and December during the course of the project.

requirements.text: The quarterly updates must be submitted electronically to the MoDOT project manager.
requirements.quote: These quarterly updates shall be submitted electronically to the MoDOT project manager.

requirements.text: An interim presentation to update MoDOT on progress must be completed by 9/15/2025.
requirements.quote: Interim presentation must be done by this date.

requirements.text: The Offeror must provide ongoing progress updates by email and phone to MoDOT contacts every month.
requirements.quote: E-mail and phone communications with MoDOT contacts are required to provide ongoing updates of progress.

requirements.text: The draft final report, summary report and user manual are due 11/3/2025.
requirements.quote: Draft final report, summary report, and user manual are due.

requirements.text: The final report, summary report, presentation and user manual are due 1/1/2026, about one month before the contract ends.
requirements.quote: Final report, summary report, presentation, and user manual due.

requirements.text: The final invoice is due and the contract ends on 2/2/2026.
requirements.quote: Final invoice due and contract ends.

requirements.text: The Offeror must facilitate a kick-off meeting with MoDOT to review the work plan, scope and schedule and to establish a protocol for regular communications and coordination.
requirements.quote: The Offeror will facilitate a kick-off meeting with MoDOT to review the work plan, scope, and schedule; and establish a protocol for regular ongoing communications and coordination with the team.

requirements.text: The Offeror must schedule and conduct quarterly project status meetings reviewing past progress and upcoming work, in person or online.
requirements.quote: The Offeror will schedule and conduct quarterly project status meetings to review progress for the previous period and anticipated work for the next period.

requirements.text: The Offeror must develop minutes for the kick-off meeting and each quarterly status meeting.
requirements.quote: The Offeror will also develop minutes for the kick-off meeting and each of the quarterly status meetings.

requirements.text: The Offeror must submit a Data Management Plan to MoDOT within two weeks after the project kick-off meeting.
requirements.quote: The Offeror is required to submit a Data Management Plan (DMP) to MoDOT within 2 weeks after the project kick-off meeting.

requirements.text: The Data Management Plan should address use of platform-independent, non-proprietary data formats to maximize future utility of the data.
requirements.quote: The DMP should address how the Offeror will use platform-independent and non-proprietary formats to ensure maximum utility of the data in the future.

requirements.text: The Offeror must conduct a thorough literature search and review of other state DOT practices using AI/ML for right-of-way purposes.
requirements.quote: A thorough literature search and review of other state DOT practices using AI/ML for ROW purposes conducted.

requirements.text: Before work begins on the proof of concept, the Offeror must provide the name of the program used to develop the legal land descriptions.
requirements.quote: Before work begins on the proof of concepts, the Offeror will provide the name of the program used to develop the LLDs.
requirements.section: Offeror Provides Program to Develop LLDs

requirements.text: MoDOT Information Systems must approve the program before the Offeror proceeds to Task 3c (proof of concept).
requirements.quote: MoDOT Information Systems must give approval before moving forward with Task 3c
requirements.section: Offeror Provides Program to Develop LLDs

requirements.text: The Offeror must demonstrate that the technology can create draft legal land descriptions on a variety of properties.
requirements.quote: The Offeror will demonstrate how the technology will create draft legal land descriptions on a variety of properties.
requirements.section: Proof of Concept that AI/ML Can Develop Legal Land Descriptions

requirements.text: The Offeror must provide training to MoDOT right-of-way staff once the system is developed and finalized.
requirements.quote: Once the system has been developed and finalized, the Offeror will provide training to ROW staff.

requirements.text: The training must come with a user manual for staff to reference.
requirements.quote: The training will also have a user manual for staff to reference.

requirements.text: The Offeror must prepare a draft Synthesis Report and Research Summary with all accompanying documentation identified as beneficial during the study.
requirements.quote: The Offeror will prepare a draft Synthesis Report and Research Summary along with all accompanying documentation identified as beneficial during the study.
requirements.section: Develop Draft Report and Research Summary

requirements.text: The draft documents should be final products apart from revisions based on MoDOT's review.
requirements.quote: These drafts should be final products except for revisions based on MoDOT's review.
requirements.section: Develop Draft Report and Research Summary

requirements.text: The final report must include a completed Technical Report Documentation page.
requirements.quote: A final report must include a completed Technical Report Documentation page.
requirements.section: Develop Draft Report and Research Summary

requirements.text: The Offeror must develop a final report detailing the tasks completed and all findings from the project.
requirements.quote: The Offeror will develop a final report detailing the tasks completed during the project, including any and all findings generated during the project's duration.
requirements.section: Develop Final Report, Research Summary, and Presentation

requirements.text: The Offeror must provide a 1-2 page research summary stating the project objectives, findings and conclusions.
requirements.quote: The Offeror will provide a 1-2 page research summary that states the project objectives, findings and conclusions.
requirements.section: Develop Final Report, Research Summary, and Presentation

requirements.text: The Offeror must provide a presentation for MoDOT staff summarizing important details of the project.
requirements.quote: A presentation for MoDOT staff summarizing important or significant details of the project must be provided.
requirements.section: Develop Final Report, Research Summary, and Presentation

requirements.text: Property descriptions prepared for MHTC must meet the requirements of the MoDOT Engineering Policy Guide.
requirements.quote: Property descriptions prepared on behalf of the MHTC must be prepared in a manner that meets the following requirements as outlined in the MoDOT Engineering Policy Guide (EPG)

requirements.text: Property rights acquired or conveyed by MHTC must be described using the metes and bounds method unless the property is acquired in its entirety.
requirements.quote: realty rights being acquired or conveyed by the MHTC must be described using the metes and bounds method, unless the property is acquired in its entirety.

requirements.text: When a property is acquired in its entirety, the description must be written exactly as it appears on the last deed of record.
requirements.quote: When acquiring a property in its entirety, the property description shall be written exactly as it appears on the last deed of record for the subject property.

requirements.text: No material or reports prepared by the Offeror may be released to the public without prior consent of MHTC's representative.
requirements.quote: No material or reports prepared by the Offeror shall be released to the public without the prior consent of MHTC's representative.

requirements.text: The Offeror may not assign, delegate or transfer any interest in the services without prior written consent of MHTC's representative.
requirements.quote: The Offeror shall not assign or delegate any interest, and shall not transfer any interest in the services to be provided (whether by assignment, delegation, or novation) without the prior written consent of MHTC's representative.

requirements.text: The Offeror remains responsible and liable to MHTC for the quality and performance of the services, regardless of any subcontractors or suppliers used.
requirements.quote: the Offeror ultimately remains responsible and liable to MHTC for the complete, accurate and professional quality/performance of these services.

requirements.text: Offerors are encouraged to obtain 10% MBE and 5% WBE participation.
requirements.quote: Offerors are encouraged to obtain 10% MBE and 5% WBE participation.

requirements.text: The Offeror must include the Executive Order employment-eligibility provisions in every subcontract.
requirements.quote: The Offeror shall include the provisions of Section (3), paragraph I of this Agreement in every subcontract.

requirements.text: The Offeror must affirm enrollment and participation in the E-Verify federal work authorization program for employees proposed to work on the services, by providing a completed copy of the E-Verify MOU.
requirements.quote: The business entity must affirm its enrollment and participation in the E-Verify federal work authorization program with respect to the employees proposed to work in connection with the services requested herein

requirements.text: The Offeror must affirm by sworn affidavit (Exhibit A) that it does not knowingly employ unauthorized aliens in connection with the contracted services.
requirements.quote: By sworn affidavit, affirm that it does not knowingly employ any person who is an unauthorized alien in connection with the contracted services.

requirements.text: If the Offeror is a sole proprietorship or partnership, each sole proprietor and general partner must provide proof of lawful presence in the United States via the Exhibit B affidavit.
requirements.quote: each sole proprietor and each general partner shall provide affirmative proof of lawful presence in the United States.
requirements.section: (L) Proof of Lawful Presence for Sole Proprietorships and Partnerships

requirements.text: All documents and reports produced by the Offeror at MHTC's direction, and information supplied by MHTC, remain MHTC's property.
requirements.quote: All documents, reports, exhibits, etc. produced by the Offeror at the direction of MHTC's representative and information supplied by MHTC's representative shall remain the property of MHTC.

requirements.text: The Offeror must maintain all working papers and records relating to the Agreement and make them available to MHTC and the State Auditor at no charge during the agreement and for three years after final payment.
requirements.quote: The Offeror must maintain all working papers and records relating to the Agreement.

requirements.text: MHTC may reproduce and use any products derived from the Offeror's work without paying royalties or fees.
requirements.quote: MHTC's representative shall have the right to reproduce and/or use any products derived from the Offeror's work without payment of any royalties, fees, etc.

requirements.text: The Offeror must comply with the award terms of 2 C.F.R. Part 170 (FFATA reporting).
requirements.quote: This Agreement is subject to the award terms within 2 C.F.R. Part 170.
requirements.section: (W) Federal Funding Accountability and Transparency Act of 2006

requirements.text: The Offeror should be able to provide certificates of general liability insurance of at least $500,000 per person per occurrence and $3,000,000 per occurrence overall.
requirements.quote: General Liability Not less than $500,000 for any one person in a single accident or occurrence, and not less than $3,000,000 for all claims arising out of a single occurrence;

requirements.text: The Offeror should be able to provide certificates of automobile liability insurance of at least $500,000 per person per occurrence and $3,000,000 per occurrence overall.
requirements.quote: Automobile Liability Not less than $500,000 for any one person in a single accident or occurrence, and not less than $3,000,000 for all claims arising out of a single occurrence;

requirements.text: The Offeror should be able to provide a Missouri workers' compensation policy or equivalent as required by state law.
requirements.quote: Missouri State Workmen's Compensation policy or equivalent in accordance with state law.

requirements.text: All applications must be developed using the approved technologies listed in the Information Technology section.
requirements.quote: All applications must be developed using one of the approved technologies below.

requirements.text: Web applications must use the MVC, Razor Pages or Web API framework.
requirements.quote: Web applications must use either the MVC, Razor Pages or Web API framework.

requirements.text: Vendors may not use third-party tools or software that place a licensing responsibility on MoDOT without prior approval from the IS Best Practices Review Team and IS management.
requirements.quote: Vendors may not use third-party tools or software which would place a licensing responsibility on MoDOT without prior review and approval of the tools and or software by the Information Systems Best Practices Review Team (BRPT) and IS management.

requirements.text: Large-scale use of Python requires approval of the IS Best Practices Review Team.
requirements.quote: Large scale use of Python requires the approval of the Information Systems (IS) Best Practices Review Team (BRPT).

requirements.text: Customer applications should be web-based, browser applications.
requirements.quote: All customer applications should be Web Based, browser applications.

requirements.text: Applications should be tested and designed for the latest IS-approved browsers at a minimum.
requirements.quote: Applications should be tested and designed to use the latest IS approved browser(s), at a minimum.

requirements.text: No client-side software other than a modern browser should be required to run the web application.
requirements.quote: No client-side software, other than a modern browser, should be required to run the web application.

requirements.text: On-premise database deployments must run on Oracle 19C or on the latest supported SQL Server (SQL Server 2016 or higher only if approved by MoDOT IS).
requirements.quote: On premise database deployments shall be ran on:

requirements.text: No personally identifiable information may be stored in any database table unless the application has a specific business need for it.
requirements.quote: No Personal Identifiable Information (PII) can be stored in any database table unless the application has a specific business need to use that data.

requirements.text: Any stored PII must be approved by the IS Cyber Security Team.
requirements.quote: All PII data that is stored must have approval from the IS Cyber Security Team.

requirements.text: All web applications must conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA.
requirements.quote: All web applications must adhere to the W3 Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.1 with a 'AA' level of conformance (WCAG 2.1 AA).

requirements.text: Content from another author's web pages must not be used unless the author explicitly allows free copying or arrangements are made with the author.
requirements.quote: Never use text, diagrams, photographs, audio, multimedia, program source code, script or graphics from another author's web pages unless the author explicitly states it may be freely copied or you make appropriate

checklist.fact: The RFP is issued by the Missouri Highways and Transportation Commission (MHTC), coordinated by the Research Unit of the Construction and Materials Division, for MoDOT as the beneficiary (Right of Way staff are the users of the tool).
checklist.quote: This document constitutes an RFP from qualified organizations to conduct the TR202504, "Using AI/ML to Write Legal Land Descriptions" study for the MHTC and Missouri Department of Transportation (MoDOT).

checklist.fact: The need: property descriptions for MHTC must be written by metes and bounds and reviewed by a professional land surveyor, and these descriptions are long and tedious to write.
checklist.quote: Needless to say, these descriptions can be long and tedious to write.

checklist.fact: The project goal is to determine the usefulness of AI and ML to develop a "first draft" legal land description using MHTC parameters, which MoDOT Right of Way staff would review and edit.
checklist.quote: The goal of this research project is to determine the usefulness of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to develop a "first draft" of  the legal land description (LLD) using the MHTC parameters.

checklist.fact: The services are capped at a not-to-exceed price of $175,000.
checklist.quote: The successful Offeror shall provide the following services not to exceed $175,000.

checklist.fact: The contract period is 15 months, with the project assumed to start November 1, 2024 and the contract ending February 2, 2026 with the final invoice due.
checklist.quote: The contract period will run for 15 months.

checklist.fact: Proposals for project TR202504 must be emailed to MoDOTResearchRFP@modot.mo.gov by August 21, 2024 at 10 a.m. Central.
checklist.quote: Please submit all proposals to **<u>MoDOTResearchRFP@modot.mo.gov</u>** by **August 21, 2024** at **10 a.m. (Central)**

checklist.fact: Questions must be submitted by 7/17/2024 4 p.m. Central via the RFP email only; contacting MoDOT employees by other methods is prohibited and is cause for disqualification.
checklist.quote:
This is the only acceptable method for contact regarding the RFP and
contacting MoDOT employees via other methods is prohibited.

checklist.fact: MoDOT will notify submitters of project selection (or interviews) on 9/18/2024.
checklist.quote:
MoDOT will notify submitters about project selection, or if needed about
interviews to finalize selection.

checklist.fact: Core deliverables include a data management plan, a proof-of-concept demonstration of AI writing legal land descriptions, training and a user manual for ROW staff, and draft and final reports; the final report, summary, presentation and user manual are due 1/1/2026.
checklist.quote: Final report, summary report, presentation, and user manual due.

checklist.fact: The Offeror must name the program used to develop the LLDs before proof-of-concept work, and MoDOT Information Systems must approve it before Task 3c proceeds.
checklist.quote: MoDOT Information Systems must give approval before moving forward with Task 3c

checklist.fact: Web applications must meet WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility conformance.
checklist.quote: All web applications must adhere to the W3 Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.1 with a 'AA' level of conformance (WCAG 2.1 AA).

checklist.fact: No PII may be stored in any database table unless there is a specific business need, and any stored PII requires approval from the IS Cyber Security Team.
checklist.quote: No Personal Identifiable Information (PII) can be stored in any database table unless the application has a specific business need to use that data.
